title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Billing and Remittance Terms
content:
# Billing and Remittance Terms — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Section 1 — When a payment can be applied

1.1 A business payment can be applied only while the unit status is in service, termination requested, off road, sold, purchased or defaulted. The status is read from the unit's own system record. A unit that is ordered or closed takes no business payment.

## Section 2 — Channels and posting

2.1 Business payments are accepted only through the tier's accepted payment channels; card payments are not accepted.

2.2 A payment received before the tier's payment cutoff time, Central Time, on a business day posts that day.

2.3 *No longer in force:* the clause by which a posted payment "is applied to the oldest unpaid invoice month first unless the remittance names the months it pays" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for applying business payments to invoice months.

## Section 3 — Due date and late-charge grace

3.1 Rental invoices are due the tier's payment terms, in calendar days, after the invoice date.

3.2 A late charge may be assessed only after the tier's late-charge grace days have fully elapsed from the invoice due date. The invoice due date is the due date printed on the rental invoice, which is the invoice date plus the payment terms in calendar days; the grace is counted in calendar days starting the day after the invoice due date, so the first permissible assessment date is the calendar day after the invoice due date plus the grace days. The due date is taken from the rental invoice of that unit and that invoice month.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the invoice due date on the rental invoice |
| Counting | calendar days, the first counted day being the day after the due date |
| Length | the tier's late-charge grace days |
| Comparison | assessment strictly after the grace has fully run |
| First permissible assessment date | the day after the due date plus the grace days |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, grace of 5 calendar days, invoice due on day 10 of a month):** the grace runs from day 11 through day 15. An assessment on day 15 is not permitted, because the grace has not fully elapsed; an assessment on day 16 is the first permitted.

3.3 Only one late charge may be assessed for the same unit and invoice month. Whether one already exists is read from that unit's postings for that invoice month.

## Section 4 — Amount of a late charge

4.1 *No longer in force:* the clause "The late charge is the late-charge percentage of the past-due invoice amount (that month's rental invoice amount less the business payments applied to that month), but never less than the late-charge minimum" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for figuring late charges.

## Section 5 — Credit balances

5.1 *No longer in force:* the clause "A credit balance left on a unit after it closes is refunded within the refund period in calendar days" is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current basis for refunding credit balances.

## Points of judgement

- A payment on a unit in a status not listed in 1.1 is not applied, whatever the business states about the unit.
- The grace test and the one-charge test are each tied to one unit and one invoice month of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease; a late charge on another month or another unit does not count against them.
